title: Bank of Hawai‘i’s Branches on Hawai‘i Island Remain Temporarily Closed; Maui County Branches to Reopen Saturday, Sept. 26
summary: Due to Hurricane Nolo, Bank of Hawai‘i branches on Hawai‘i Island will remain temporarily closed until further notice. Bank of Hawai‘i branches in Maui County that normally operate on Saturdays will reopen tomorrow, Sept. 26, during their regular hours of 9 a.m. to 1 p.m.
body_markdown:
Due to Hurricane Nolo, Bank of Hawai‘i branches on Hawai‘i Island will remain temporarily closed until further notice.


Bank of Hawai‘i branches in Maui County that normally operate on Saturdays will reopen tomorrow, Sept. 26, during their regular hours of 9 a.m. to 1 p.m.


The bank will continue to assess the status of its branch network, and will update the public on branch closures and reopenings as the hurricane continues on its path.


Bank of Hawai‘i’s Contact Center operations remain open to assist customers and can be reached at (808) 643-3888. Online and mobile banking and ATM services will continue to operate unless power interruptions are experienced.


Bank of Hawai‘i will also place public updates on its social media platforms (Facebook:[www.facebook.com/bankofhawaii](http://www.facebook.com/bankofhawaii) , Instagram:[www.instagram.com/bankofhawaii](http://www.instagram.com/bankofhawaii) and X (formerly Twitter:[www.twitter.com/bankofhawaii](http://www.twitter.com/bankofhawaii) ), as well as its website:[www.boh.com](https://www.boh.com/) .
